newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas says will pay BP in cash, not assets.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas says will pay BP in cash, not assets.

text.p: British Gas said it will compensate British Petroleum fully in cash for sweetening the terms of the take-or-pay long-term gas supply contract.
At a press conference, British Gas chairman Richard Giordano said there were, however, talks going on with other gas producers in which payment in kind rather than cash was part of the discussion.
"There are discussions on assets. That is all I can tell you," he told journalists.
Analysts had earlier suggested that British Gas would pay BP by giving it an interest in its Morecambe Bay gas field.
Giordano said Morecambe did play a role in renegotiations with some other producers.
"It...is an important asset in the solution of the take-or-pay," he said.
Giordano declined to say how much BP would be paid.
